posts.title: You make the team
posts.description: We talk about great teams and great companies as if their excellence is something you inherit by joining them. As if the quality lives out there and all you need to do is step in for you to become excellent.

posts.title: Thinking beyond the ask
posts.description: In large organizations, work often arrives already shaped in the form of a ticket, a feature spec or a defined task. Each team owns a slice: product defines, engineering builds, analysts measure, ML tunes. It keeps things moving, but it also narrows how we think.

posts.title: Krakow, Poland
posts.description: I reached Krakow around noon on Monday, May 4th. The flight from Frankfurt was short and the view from above wasn’t anything special.
